gbm_population_evidence.quote: Pathologically confirmed glioblastoma (including all histological variants; documentation to be provided) that are newly diagnosed (for Arms A and B) or relapsed disease (for Arm C, D and E)

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a Phase 1/2 study of selinexor in combination with standard of care (SoC) therapy for newly diagnosed glioblastoma (nGBM) or recurrent glioblastoma (rGBM).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Study of Selinexor in Combination With Standard of Care Therapy for Newly Diagnosed or Recurrent Glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Phase 1a and 1b: Maximum Plasma Concentration (Cmax) of Selinexor: Cmax of Selinexor was reported.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: RP2D was determined based on the totality of the available safety, efficacy, pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD).

role_evidence.quote: will independently evaluate 3 different combination regimens in 3 treatment arms in patients with nGBM (Arms A and B) or with rGBM (Arm C).
[DRUG] Selinexor (other names: KPT-330, XPOVIO): Dose and Formulation: 20 milligram (mg); Tablet Route of Administration: Oral

agents.drug_class_hint: XPO1 (exportin-1) inhibitor, approved for haematological malignancies

role_evidence.quote: Arm B: evaluating the combination of selinexor with radiation therapy and temozolomide (TMZ) (S-TRT) in nGBM participants with methylated-O6-methylguanine-DNA-methyltransferase (mMGMT)

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

role_evidence.quote: Arm C: evaluating the combination of selinexor with lomustine (or carmustine, if lomustine is not available) (S-L/C) in rGBM participants regardless of MGMT status

agents.drug_class_hint: nitrosourea alkylating agent, established GBM therapy

role_evidence.quote: Participants with rGBM uMGMT or mMGMT will receive 110 mg/m\^2 of lomustine or 200 mg/m\^2 of Carmustine (substituted if lomustine is not available) capsule on Day 1 of each cycle in a 42-day cycle for all cycles.

agents.drug_class_hint: nitrosourea alkylating agent, established GBM therapy (substitute for lomustine)

role_evidence.quote: Arm D: evaluating the combination of selinexor with bevacizumab in rGBM participants regardless of MGMT status

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody, established GBM therapy

source_quote.quote: Arm A: evaluating the combination of selinexor with radiation therapy (S-RT) in nGBM participants with uMGMT
Participants with mutated isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) should be excluded for Phase 2.

coder_notes: Selinexor is the only investigational agent in each experimental arm (on different SoC backbones) -> experimental_monotherapy; trial regimen combination. Temozolomide is in control only for Arm A (uMGMT) and backbone in Arm B; lomustine/carmustine and bevacizumab are SoC partners (Arm D has no registered control). MGMT status defines Arm A (unmethylated) vs Arm B (methylated) -> enrichment, not candidate-matched. IDH-mutant excluded for Phase 2 only; cns5 coded on that basis although 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' also appears (historical). PK/PD mentioned only generically for RP2D; only plasma Cmax specified -> tumour PK no, target engagement no.
